name: Apple Festival
tagline: Welcome to Country Apple Orchard in Harrisburg, SD
description: In Harrisburg, SD, Apple Festival raises Apples and Pumpkins on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
